qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Direct overseas sourcing scale and unmatched Canadian store network density (>1,600 stores) yield the lowest retail cost structure in Canada. Successful rollout of multi-price tiers up to $5.00 demonstrated strong pricing power with zero customer churn, preserving 44-45% gross margins and driving GAAP ROIC >45% (Operating ROIC >80%). Primary erosion threats: wage inflation, supply chain disruption, and long-term domestic store saturation.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Dominant Canadian extreme-value retail monopoly operating a classic scale economies shared flywheel. Unrivaled store density, overseas direct sourcing scale, <2-year store payback economics, and disciplined international compounding via Dollarcity (LatAm) and The Reject Shop (Australia). Pristine cash conversion (>110% FCF/NI) and interest coverage (>9.6x EBIT, >11.5x EBITDA) confirm negative equity was an accounting artifact of treasury share cancellations, not balance sheet distress. [5-10Y g: Canadian store traffic 2.0% + store network expansion (Canada, LatAm & Australia) 3.5% + multi-price tiering 1.5% + net share repurchases 2.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Operating ROIC >50% (GAAP ROIC ~22-26% including IFRS 16 lease liabilities, and ~45-57% on net operating assets). Free cash flow conversion averaged 115% of Net Income over FY2023-FY2026. Gross margins pristine at 44.7% and EBIT margins expanded to 27.1%. Net funded debt is $1.90B CAD against TTM Net Income of $1.31B CAD (1.45x Net Debt/NI, well below 4.0x ceiling) with EBIT interest coverage of 9.6x and EBITDA interest coverage of 11.9x. Uninterrupted peak-to-peak diluted EPS compounding from $1.78 in FY2020 to $5.39 in FY2025.
